svg.aria-label: sage: your chief of staff for Claude Code. Send sage mode as a message of its own. A hooded toad sage, the chief of staff, meditates in a misty mountain world, with calm gold toad eyes. Around it, its team on a loop: designer, PE, implementer, arena judge, code reviewer, security reviewer, UX reviewer and QA. Claude Code plugin, MIT. Built on pstack and poteto mode, by Lauren Tan.
